info.title: Space Drive API (target)
info.description:
Binding OpenAPI for Drive under `/api/v1`. Hand-written target contract. `scripts/export-openapi.ps1` does not generate or overwrite this file.

## Document role
This file is the **binding source of truth** for Drive implementation, contract tests, and clients for the new storage surface.
It is **not** the PDF domain transcript and **not** the exported parked host reality (`drive-target.openapi.json`).

Domain intent (roles, people vs files, product behavior) lives in `docs/Drive-API-contracts 2.pdf` and `docs/Drive-API-contracts.openapi.json`. Map PDF requirements into this file (or `hub-target.openapi.json`) before implementing.

Hub owns identity and token issuance. Auth paths (`sign-ins`, `two-factor-confirmations`, `token-refreshes`, `app-tokens*`, JWKS) live in `hub-target.openapi.json`. Drive only **verifies** Hub-issued JWTs via Hub JWKS.

## Base URL
All routes are under `/api/v1`.

## Authentication
Every route requires `Authorization: Bearer` with a Hub-issued access JWT (or Hub-issued app token). Drive does not issue user tokens.
Validate JWT with Hub `GET /api/v1/.well-known/jwks.json`. Authorize with workspace claims plus Drive-local project membership and node ACL.

## Identifiers
Identifiers are server-generated opaque strings. Callers do not parse them. The server form is:
- `workspace:{int}` workspace
- `namespace:personal:{userId}` and `namespace:workspace:{workspaceId}`
- `root:personal:{userId}` and `root:workspace:{workspaceId}`
- `group:{int}`, `asset:{int}`, `scene:{int}`, `flow:{int}`
Dispatch ids are new server-generated strings.

## Methods
- `POST` that creates an addressable resource returns `201 Created`, the resource, and a `Location` header. Addressable creates are storage nodes.
- Dispatch notification returns `201` with the body and no `Location`. That body has no resource URL.
- `POST /api/v1/storage-dispatches` returns `200` and an `application/x-ndjson` stream. The body is the event stream, not a stored dispatch document.
- `PATCH` returns `200` and the same `StorageNode` as `GET` with `Accept: application/json`.

## Lists
`GET /api/v1/storage-nodes` uses `page` (default 1), `pageSize` (default 20, maximum 100), and `sort` (default `name`). `page` below 1 or `pageSize` outside 1–100 returns `400` with `error: invalid_pagination` and is not clamped. Unknown `sort` fields return `400` with `error: invalid_sort`. `=` means equality. Allowed `sort` fields are `name`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`, and `id`. Prefix `-` for descending.
Omitted or `trashed=false` hides nodes with `trashedAt` set. `trashed=true` includes them.
`GET /api/v1/storage-changes` is continued with `cursor`, not `page`.

## Content negotiation
`GET /api/v1/storage-nodes/{id}`:
- omitted `Accept`, `*/*`, or `application/json` returns the node
- `application/octet-stream` returns the file bytes
- any other type returns `406 Not Acceptable`
`PUT /api/v1/storage-nodes/{id}` accepts only `application/octet-stream`. A JSON body returns `415 Unsupported Media Type`. The success body is the `StorageNode`.
Byte read and write are supported for `kind` `asset` and `scene`. `group`, `root`, and `flow` return `406` for byte read and write. Scene bytes are the scene JSON file. Asset bytes are the stored file, including a ZIP package when that is what is stored.
`POST /api/v1/storage-dispatches` requires `Accept: application/x-ndjson`. Any other value returns `406`.

## Errors
Every `4xx` and `5xx` response is `application/problem+json` (`ProblemDetails`): `type`, `title`, `status`, `detail`, `instance`, `error`, `requestId`. Validation failures use `error: validation_failed` and an `errors` object keyed by camelCase field name.
Every response includes `X-Request-Id`, matching `requestId` in error bodies. The server generates the request id. A client-supplied correlation id is not the request id.
When several failures apply, the first match wins: `401` authentication, `403` authenticated but not allowed, `400` validation, `404` missing resource, `406` unacceptable `Accept`, `415` unsupported request `Content-Type`.

## Domain mapping
This surface is a view over workspaces, groups, assets, scenes, and flows. It does not remove those legacy routes until cutover.

`StorageNamespace` is one personal namespace plus one namespace for each workspace membership.
- `id`, `kind` (`personal` or `workspace`), `title`, `userId`, and `rootNodeId` are always set.
- `workspaceId` is the workspace id, or `null` on the personal namespace.
- `organizationId` is `null` until an organization resource exists.
- `roots` on `DriveListing` are the synthetic root nodes for those namespaces.

`StorageNode.kind` is `root`, `group`, `asset`, `scene`, or `flow`. `appKind` is the asset type or the workspace type when one exists, otherwise `null`.
- `name`, `createdAt`, and `updatedAt` come from the group, asset, scene, flow, or workspace.
- `parentId` is the parent group, or the namespace root when the item sits at the top of that namespace. Roots use `null`.
- `namespaceId` is the personal namespace or the workspace namespace that contains the node.
- `assetId` is the asset id when the node is an asset, otherwise `null`.
- `groupId` is the primary group. Further memberships stay on the current group-link routes. Personal items and roots use `null`.
- `role` is the caller's node ACL (`viewer|editor|owner`) or legacy `currentUserRole`, or `null` when none.
- `isPersonal` is true for personal-space items and the personal root.
- `mime`, `extension`, `byteSize`, and `contentHash` come from stored bytes when those values exist, otherwise `null`.
- `inheritGrants`, `readOnly`, and `cloudOnly` are `false` until the product stores them.
- `trashedAt` is `null` until `DELETE /api/v1/storage-nodes/{id}` writes it. Delete sets `trashedAt` and leaves the row in place.

No table exists yet for `trashedAt`, the change cursor log, dispatches, or open links (`spaceUrl`, `href`). This contract defines those fields. The implementation has to store them.

get.description: `current` is the authenticated caller's listing: one personal namespace and one namespace per workspace membership, with their root nodes.

200.description: The caller's namespaces and root nodes.

get.description: Returns the children of `parentId` as a paged collection. The parent node is `GET /api/v1/storage-nodes/{id}`. Follow `page` until `totalCount` is covered.

get.summary: Get a storage node or its file bytes.

200.description: The node, or its file bytes when Accept is application/octet-stream.

patch.summary: Rename a storage node or move it under another parent.
patch.description: Send `name`, `parentId`, or both. `parentId` is the move. At least one field is required. The response is the same StorageNode as GET.

put.summary: Replace the file bytes of a storage node.
put.description: Content-Type must be application/octet-stream. JSON returns 415. kind group, root, and flow return 406. Success returns the StorageNode.

200.description: Bytes replaced. Body is the storage node.

delete.description: Sets trashedAt and leaves the row in place. Lists hide the node until trashed=true.

204.description: The node was trashed. No response body.

get.summary: List storage changes for a namespace.
get.description: Omit cursor on the first call. Continue with the cursor of the last StorageChange. An empty changes array means the client is caught up. This list does not use page or pageSize.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Return changes after this cursor. Omit on the first call.

get.summary: Get the Space link for a storage node.

200.description: Space URL and href for the node.

post.description: Accept must be application/x-ndjson. The response is one DispatchEvent JSON object per line. Status is 200 because the body is the event stream, not a stored dispatch document.

post.summary: Email a notification for a dispatch.

201.description: Notification accepted. The body has no resource id, so there is no Location header.

bearerAuth.description: Hub-issued access JWT or Hub-issued app token. Verified via Hub JWKS. Drive does not issue tokens.

RequestId.description: Server-generated request id. Matches requestId in ProblemDetails.

ParentId.name: parentId
ParentId.description: Parent node whose children are listed. Equality match.

Trashed.name: trashed
Trashed.description: When false or omitted, nodes with trashedAt set are hidden. When true, those nodes are included.

Page.name: page
Page.description: 1-based page index. Default 1. Values below 1 return 400 invalid_pagination.

PageSize.name: pageSize
PageSize.description: Page size. Default 20. Values outside 1–100 return 400 invalid_pagination and are not clamped.

Sort.name: sort
Sort.description: Ascending field, or -field for descending. Allowed: name, createdAt, updatedAt, id. Default name. Unknown fields return 400 invalid_sort.

Accept.name: Accept
Accept.description: application/json, or omitted, or */*, returns the node. application/octet-stream returns file bytes. Any other value returns 406.

BadRequest.description: The query or body is invalid. error is validation_failed, invalid_pagination, or invalid_sort.

Unauthorized.description: Authentication failed. This wins over validation, a missing resource, and an unacceptable Accept value.

Forbidden.description: The caller is authenticated and is not allowed to use this resource.

NotFound.description: The resource does not exist or is not visible to the caller.

NotAcceptable.description: The Accept value cannot be produced, or this node kind has no file bytes.

UnsupportedMediaType.description: PUT storage node content requires Content-Type application/octet-stream.

ProblemDetails.description: RFC 9457 problem body used for every 4xx and 5xx response.

error.description: Machine-readable code. Validation uses validation_failed. Pagination uses invalid_pagination. Sort uses invalid_sort.

requestId.description: Server-generated request id. Matches the X-Request-Id header.

errors.description: Present when error is validation_failed. Keys are camelCase field names.

roots.description: Synthetic root node for each namespace.

StorageNamespace.description: One personal namespace for the caller, plus one namespace per workspace membership. organizationId is null until an organization resource exists. workspaceId is null on the personal namespace.

title.description: Workspace name, or the personal namespace title.

StorageNode.description: One view over a workspace root, group, asset, scene, or flow. kind is root, group, asset, scene, or flow. name, createdAt, and updatedAt come from that resource. parentId is the parent group or the namespace root, and is null on roots. namespaceId is the personal or workspace namespace. assetId is set on assets and otherwise null. groupId is the primary group; personal items and roots use null; extra memberships stay on the current group-link routes. role is currentUserRole or null. isPersonal is true for personal-space items. mime, extension, byteSize, and contentHash come from stored bytes, or are null. inheritGrants, readOnly, and cloudOnly are false until the product stores them. trashedAt is null until this surface trashes the node. Byte read and write apply to asset and scene. group, root, and flow return 406 for bytes. Scene bytes are the scene JSON file. Asset bytes are the stored file.

appKind.description: Asset type or workspace type when one exists.

inheritGrants.description: False until the product stores this flag.

readOnly.description: False until the product stores this flag.

cloudOnly.description: False until the product stores this flag.

role.description: Caller's currentUserRole when the source resource has one.

trashedAt.description: Null until DELETE on this surface writes it. No trash column exists yet.

StorageNodePage.description: Same page envelope as the current collection responses: page, pageSize, totalCount, and the nodes.

StorageChange.description: One change in the namespace log. The log is new persistence. op values produced by this surface are create, update, move, content, and trash.

cursor.description: Pass as the cursor query on the next call.

kind.description: Creates a group, asset, scene, or flow under the parent. Roots are not created by this call.

UpdateStorageNodeRequest.description: At least one of name or parentId. parentId moves the node.

StorageOpen.description: Open link for a node. spaceUrl and href have no column today; the implementation has to store or derive them.

DispatchEvent.description: One JSON object in the application/x-ndjson stream. The source lists these fields and does not say which appear on every event. Dispatch state is new persistence.
